Class DisposalObject

java.lang.Object
com.github.jjbcoding.trellis.service.disposal.object.internal.DisposalObjectInternal
com.github.jjbcoding.trellis.service.disposal.object.DisposalObject
public class DisposalObject extends DisposalObjectInternal
A DisposalObject accumulates Nodes and Injectables that are to be disposed of. Its purpose is to be passed to an object implementing IDisposalProcessor.
